correctness.rationale: For each separation the exact quadratic resultant confines primes; modular root pairs and valuations give all edges on five/three-point windows. Universal six/four-point obstructions follow from repeated residues modulo 3/2. CRT multiplication proves all 399/10 run and edge counts, and prime-cyclic projection rigidity proves exact least periods. The actual standalone verifier independently enumerates full periods, checks direct gcds against modular criteria, and checks further starts. No finite testing is substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The three degree-two cyclotomic polynomials form a canonical complete natural family at the sharp curvature boundary f''=2 of recent arbitrarily-long-coprime-block results. The theorem supplies a complete structural classification of maximal pairwise-coprime lengths, their least periods, their positive densities, exact local gcd-graph laws, and universal finite cutoffs; this is a motivated natural exact classification, rather than a selected numeric example or a routine substitution in the source theorem.
